title: Boundary layers and vanishing diffusivity in run-and-tumble models
summary: A notable feature of confined active matter systems is the tendency for motile particles to accumulate near solid boundaries. In various linear models with no-flux boundary conditions, this accumulation is realized through the development of sharp boundary layers at small particle diffusivity $κ$. In this paper, we present the first rigorous investigation of nonlinear boundary layers in the context of confined active matter.
